interval_years.quote: All optometrists desiring to continue practice shall annually, prior to March 1, secure from the secretary-treasurer of the board a renewal certificate

required.quote: all optometrists now or hereafter licensed in the Commonwealth of Kentucky are and shall be required to take annual courses of study in subjects relating to the practice of optometry

hours_per_period.quote: The length and content of study shall be prescribed by the board but shall not exceed eight (8) hours in any calendar year

period_years.quote: All optometrists desiring to continue practice shall annually, prior to March 1, secure from the secretary-treasurer of the board a renewal certificate

value: subjects relating to the practice of optometry
ocular therapy and pharmacology (for therapeutically authorized optometrists, up to additional 17 hours)
topical_requirements.quote: with the exception of those optometrists who are authorized to prescribe therapeutic agents who shall be required to have additional credit hours of continuing education in ocular therapy and pharmacology, the amount of required credit hours to be determined by the board, but not to exceed an additional seventeen (17) credit hours, for a total not to exceed twenty-five (25) credit hours per year

available.quote: The board may license by endorsement an optometrist who holds a valid license that was obtained by examination from another state or territory of the United States

requirements.value: Applicant must have engaged in active practice for at least 5 years, have no pending board actions or malpractice suits, meet all qualifications for regular state licensure, and pay a fee not to exceed $700.
requirements.quote: Has engaged in the active practice of optometry for at least five (5) years immediately preceding his or her application for licensure

exists.quote: The Kentucky Board of Optometric Examiners shall consist of five (5) members appointed by the Governor.

national_association.quote: appointed by the Governor from a list containing three (3) names for each appointment recommended by the Kentucky Optometric Association

title_protection.quote: Uses the words "optometrist," "doctor of optometry," the letters "O.D," or other letters or title in connection with his or her name, which in any way represents him or her as being engaged in the practice of optometry

scope_protection.quote: To practice optometry, directly or indirectly, or to hold oneself out as being able so to do without first having obtained a license from the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in any practice of fraud or deceit in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in any practice of fraud or deceit in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of any felony or has been convicted of a misdemeanor involving sexual misconduct

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Chronic or persistent inebriety or addiction to a drug habit to an extent that continued practice is dangerous to patients or to the public safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Was granted a license upon a mistake of material fact.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed, procured, induced, aided, or abetted any person not holding a Kentucky license to practice optometry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employed, procured, induced, aided, or abetted any person, not holding a Kentucky license, to practice optometry or in practicing optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used the title 'doctor' without further qualifying it with the word 'optometrist' or suitable designation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Used the title "doctor" or its abbreviation without further qualifying this title or abbreviation with the word "optometrist" or suitable words or letters designating an optometry degree

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in any conduct likely to deceive or defraud the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in any conduct likely to deceive or defraud the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any order issued by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated any order issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had a license to practice optometry in another jurisdiction revoked, suspended, limited, or subjected to disciplinary action.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Had his or her license to practice optometry in any other jurisdiction revoked, suspended, limited, placed on conditions of probation, or subjected to any other disciplinary action by that jurisdiction's licensing authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribed any therapeutic agent in an amount known or should be known to be excessive under accepted standards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribed any therapeutic agent in an amount that the optometrist knows, or should know, is excessive under accepted and prevailing standards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Developed a physical or mental disability or other condition rendering continued practice dangerous to patients or the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Developed a physical or mental disability, or other condition, which renders the continued practice by the optometrist dangerous to patients or the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any statute under this chapter or administrative regulation promulgated under those statutes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated any statute under this chapter or administrative regulation promulgated under those statutes

establishment_regulation_required.quote: No person shall practice optometry on premises not separate from premises whereon eyeglasses, lenses, eyeglass frames or any other merchandise or products are sold by any other person.

definition_quote.value: The evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or surgical, nonsurgical, or related treatment of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the eye and its appendages and their impact on the human body provided by an optometrist within the scope of his or her education, training, and experience and in accordance with this chapter, the ethics of the profession, and applicable law.
definition_quote.quote: The evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or surgical, nonsurgical, or related treatment of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the eye and its appendages and their impact on the human body provided by an optometrist within the scope of his or her education, training, and experience and in accordance with this chapter, the ethics of the profession, and applicable law.

value: examination, diagnosis, and treatment of the human eye and its appendages
prescribing and adapting lenses, contact lenses, spectacles, eyeglasses, prisms, ocular devices
all routes of administration of pharmaceutical agents
vision therapy or orthoptics
low vision rehabilitation
laser surgery procedures (excluding retina, LASIK, and PRK)
surgical procedures not excluded by statute
methods_authorized.quote: Prescribing and adapting lenses, contact lenses, spectacles, eyeglasses, prisms, ocular devices, and all routes of administration of pharmaceutical agents, as authorized by KRS 320.240; or Employing vision therapy or orthoptics, low vision rehabilitation, and laser surgery procedures, excluding retina, LASIK, and PRK.

drug_authority.value: Therapeutically certified optometrists may prescribe therapeutic pharmaceutical agents and oral medications (except Schedule I controlled substances and Schedule II other than hydrocodone combination products); Schedule II hydrocodone, and Schedule III-V controlled substances limited to 72-hour supply with no refills.
drug_authority.quote: Any therapeutically certified optometrist licensed under the provisions of this subsection shall be authorized to prescribe oral medications, except any controlled substances classified in Schedule I and any controlled substances classified in Schedule II other than hydrocodone combination products as defined in KRS 218A.010, for any condition which an optometrist is authorized to treat under the provisions of this chapter.

surgery_prohibited.quote: The practice of optometry includes the correction and relief of ocular abnormalities by surgical procedures not excluded in paragraph (b) of this subsection

surgery_definition.value: Surgical procedures are within scope except specifically excluded nonlaser and laser procedures listed in KRS 320.210(2)(b), including retina laser, LASIK, PRK, enucleation, full-thickness corneal/scleral incision, penetrating keratoplasty, iris/ciliary body incision, vitreous incision, retina incision, crystalline lens extraction, intraocular implants, extraocular muscle surgery, eyelid malignancy/cosmetic/mechanical surgery, bony orbit surgery, lacrimal system surgery (except probing), full-thickness conjunctivoplasty, nonlaser surgery not correcting ocular abnormalities, posterior chamber injections for macular/retinal disease, and general anesthesia.
surgery_definition.quote: The following procedures are excluded from the scope of practice of optometry, except for the preoperative and postoperative care of these procedures

value: laser surgery procedures (excluding retina laser procedures, LASIK, and PRK)
laser_procedures_authorized.quote: laser surgery procedures, excluding retina, LASIK, and PRK

value: lacrimal probing or related procedures
paracentesis in an emergency situation requiring immediate reduction of the pressure inside the eye
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: Incisional or excisional nonlaser surgery of the lacrimal system other than lacrimal probing or related procedures

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: the board may authorize only those persons who have qualified for use of diagnostic pharmaceutical agents as set out in subsection (12) of this section to utilize and prescribe therapeutic pharmaceutical agents in the examination or treatment of any condition of the eye or its appendages

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: The use of injections for other than treatment of the human eye and its appendages shall be limited to the administration of benadryl, epinephrine, or equivalent medication to counteract anaphylaxis or anaphylactic reaction.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: Employing vision therapy or orthoptics, low vision rehabilitation, and laser surgery procedures, excluding retina, LASIK, and PRK.

immunization_authority.quote: In a public health emergency, the commissioner of health may authorize therapeutically licensed optometrists to administer inoculation for systemic health reasons.

opioid_prescription_day_limit.quote: The authority to prescribe a Schedule II hydrocodone combination product as defined in KRS 218A.010 and a Schedule III, IV, or V controlled substance shall be limited to prescriptions for a quantity sufficient to provide treatment for up to seventy-two (72) hours.

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: Any therapeutically certified optometrist licensed under the provisions of this subsection shall be authorized to prescribe oral medications, except any controlled substances classified in Schedule I and any controlled substances classified in Schedule II other than hydrocodone combination products

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: An optometrist shall not administer drugs, prescribe drugs, or perform laser or nonlaser surgery procedures until he or she is licensed by the board. Any therapeutically licensed optometrist authorized to practice under this section shall meet the educational and competence criteria set forth by the board in order to perform expanded therapeutic procedures.

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: These six (6) semester hours are in addition to the six (6) semester hours required by subsection (12) of this section, making a total of twelve (12) semester hours.

telemedicine_authorized.quote: A treating optometrist who provides or facilitates the use of telehealth shall ensure: (a) That the informed consent of the patient, or another appropriate person with authority to make the health care treatment decision for the patient, is obtained before services are provided through telehealth
